svg.title: Sovereign AI Standard — certificate template (A4 landscape)
svg.desc: Fill the bracketed fields. The band at the foot is reserved for the V-Seal microprint field; the medallion at its right end is the assay medallion that lights on verification.
svg.text: CERTIFICATE OF CERTIFICATION · ISSUED UNDER SOVEREIGN AI STANDARD V1.0
has been assessed by an accredited independent assessor and holds
against Sovereign AI Standard v1.0, Track [ A / B ], across all seven dimensions of AI control.
Certification is product-scoped and evidences the published criteria at the level stated; it does not certify accuracy, safety, fairness or fitness for purpose.
The certificate is the Standard's record; its status is live on the public register, whichever accredited assessor issued it.
REPLACE WITH THE BADGE FOR THE LEVEL HELD
V-SEAL FIELD · vseal-cert-1 · RESERVED FOR THE STIGMERGIC MICROPRINT · THE ASSAY MEDALLION AT RIGHT LIGHTS ON VERIFICATION
SOVEREIGNAI IS A CERTIFICATION MARK OF SOVEREIGN TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS CORPORATION · USPTO SERIAL NO. 99861987 · REGISTRATION PENDING
